tables.text_helper: Table 132, "XSPI register map and reset values", in section 19.7.28 (XSPI register map) on page 551. Register map: offsets, 32-bit field layout and reset values for 28 registers: XSPI_CR, Reserved, XSPI_DCR1, XSPI_DCR2, XSPI_DCR3, XSPI_DCR4, XSPI_SR, XSPI_FCR, XSPI_DLR, XSPI_AR, XSPI_DR, XSPI_PSMKR and 16 more.
